Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver

Interface DisplayServerAppInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
AppConnectorPrivate, ClientHandler, DisplayServerControl
public interface DisplayServerAppInterface
The definition of the connection layer between an application and the looking glass display server. The implementation should handle the adding and removing of frames (applications) and cursors to the display server by the client applications. Additionally it should handle the listening methods for the client.
